label: The De ente first source is the same being as a necessary CONCRETE_6 underived candidate at w
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, unattributed: some ONE being n satisfies, at the same carrier, grounding profile m, world w and q3 profile p, both the body of ce7edf53 (an actual concrete root of the selected grounding at w, in act, with esse equal to essence, no actual cause of its esse, and a finite actual esse-cause path to every other being in act) and the body of 0bdcf366 (concrete, existing at w, existing at every accessible world, with no selected ground from an existing concrete candidate at ANY admitted world). Not asserted: that roothood at w gives all-world underivedness, that n is the only necessary individual, that n has non-concrete support, or any divine attribute.
